notes: Read all 426 source lines with line numbers before porting. L1-13 imports: react-i18next useTranslation -> inlined native useTranslation() (t(key, fallback?) returns the English fallback/key, no i18n runtime); lucide-react glyphs (Rocket/CheckCircle/Clock/Star/Zap/Bell/Smartphone/Cloud/Brain/Plug/Shield/Map/BarChart3/Leaf/Globe/Wrench/Users) -> a local ICON_GLYPH text-glyph map + color-aware GlyphIcon (RN has no SVG icon set; the app icon system is glyph-based); @/components/layout/PageContainer -> inlined native PageContainer (ScrollView + header); @/components/ui {GlassPanel,Badge} -> the ported native GlassPanel + an inlined Badge; @/components/motion {FadeIn,StaggerContainer,StaggerItem} -> the ported native FadeIn (Stagger collapses to a stacked View whose cards FadeIn with an incremental delay); usePageTitle -> native no-op; @/lib/cn -> dropped (responsive grid classes have no native effect; cards stack 1-up = the web mobile breakpoint); type RoadmapPhase from @/types/admin -> the same union defined inline.

L19-25 RoadmapEntry interface ported; the web `icon: React.ElementType` (a lucide node) becomes `icon: RoadmapIconName` (a glyph key) — the only field-type change, required because RN cannot render lucide components.

L27-32 phaseConfig ported verbatim: done {Completed,#10b981,success} / current {In Progress,#00f0ff,info} / next {Up Next,#a855f7,warning} / future {Future,#f59e0b,danger}. Every label/color/variant preserved; the per-phase hex colors are kept exactly and applied directly to native style props (dots, icon tint box `${color}15`, glyph color, section heading color, blob).
L34-39 PHASE_ICONS ported (done->check, current->zap, next->star, future->rocket) as glyph keys.

L45-307 roadmapItems: all 16 entries ported VERBATIM — every title, description, phase, icon (mapped to its glyph key), and all 113 feature strings copied exactly character-for-character (Core Platform/Smart Notifications/Intelligence & Observability/Fleet Telemetry/Premium UI/External Integrations/Enhanced Visualization/Helix & Predictive Analytics/Enterprise & Scale/Mobile App/Advanced Fleet Intelligence/Smart Routing & Navigation/Security & Privacy/Smart Home & EV Ecosystem/Community & Social/Developer Platform/Global & Multi-Brand).

L313-354 RoadmapCard: the GlassPanel card with the absolute phase-colored blob (web `blur-[60px] opacity-5` -> a faint opacity-0.05 phase-colored circle clipped by overflow:'hidden', blur unavailable on RN — documented), the tinted icon box (`backgroundColor: ${phase.color}15`) + GlyphIcon (color: phase.color), the title (text-sm semibold primary) + description (text-[10px] muted), and the phase Badge (t(`roadmap.phase.${item.phase}`, phase.label)) all ported. The feature <ul> -> a native list; the per-row leading glyph branch (done->green CheckCircle / current->cyan Zap / else->muted Clock) is reproduced exactly (#4ade80 green-400, #22d3ee cyan-400, colors.textMuted), and each feature string renders in text-xs secondary.

L360-426 RoadmapPage: useTranslation + usePageTitle(t('roadmap.title','Roadmap')) kept; phases=['done','current','next','future'] preserved. PageContainer(title=roadmap.title, subtitle=roadmap.subtitle verbatim copy) wraps (1) the FadeIn'd progress-bar GlassPanel — a horizontal ScrollView (overflow-x-auto) of per-phase markers: a colored dot (w-2.5 h-2.5), the colored label (t(`roadmap.phase.${phase}`,config.label)), a count Badge (roadmapItems.filter(...).length), and a hairline separator rendered only when i<phases.length-1 — and (2) one section per non-empty phase: a FadeIn'd heading (PhaseIcon glyph + colored label) above the stacked, FadeIn-staggered RoadmapCards. Every i18n key, the filter/count logic, the empty-phase skip, and the phase-color styling are preserved.

Native-safe substitutions: react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, @/lib/cn, and the web PageContainer/Badge are replaced by inlined RN equivalents; FadeIn + GlassPanel reuse the already-ported native components. No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported. All Tailwind className styling -> a StyleSheet + theme tokens. A smoke test (__tests__/RoadmapPage.test.tsx) renders the page and asserts the title/subtitle, all four phase labels + counts, representative card titles across every phase, and feature strings.
Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest).
